## The claim

Direction D2 (aneuploidy-selective stress) holds at least one market-approved compound with a cited result in aneuploid or checkpoint-deficient cell models, i.e. rung 2 or higher, and that evidence is for the approved molecule itself rather than only for an unapproved tool compound.

**Prediction if true.** At least one approved drug acting on a D2 target (autophagy, proteasome, AMPK/energy stress, HSP90 or mTOR axis) carries a curated evidence row at rung 2 or higher with proxy=false; chloroquine or hydroxychloroquine is expected to be one from the Tang 2011 screen.

**What would refute it.** Every D2 evidence row at rung 2 or higher names an unapproved compound (AICAR, 17-AAG) with proxy=true, or no D2 row reaches rung 2 at all.
